CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_TRY_SDI]
( 
	[H] [varchar](50)  NULL,
	[Beneficiary]	VARCHAR (255),
	[Beneficiary_Id]	int ,
	[CBCGLAcctEncryted]	VARCHAR (255),
	[CBCGLAcctSixDigits]	VARCHAR (255),
	[Currencies]	VARCHAR (255),
	[Direct]	VARCHAR(5),
	[Id]	int ,
	[Method]	VARCHAR (32),
	[Pay_Receive]	VARCHAR (22),
	[ProcessingOrg]	VARCHAR (255),
	[Products]	VARCHAR (1024),
	[Roles]	VARCHAR (32),
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime2](7)  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
);

CREATE TABLE [EDS].[TRY_SDI]
( 
	[Beneficiary]	VARCHAR (255),
	[Beneficiary_Id]	int ,
	[CBCGLAcctEncryted]	VARCHAR (255),
	[CBCGLAcctSixDigits]	VARCHAR (255),
	[Currencies]	VARCHAR (255),

	[Method]	VARCHAR (32),
	[Pay_Receive]	VARCHAR (22),

	[Products]	VARCHAR (1024),
	[Roles]	VARCHAR (32),

	[isLatest] [char](1)  NULL,

(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH([BENEFICIARY_ID]),
	HEAP
